text: dsh-plugin-show-image 是一个 DSH Web 图片显示插件：它在 DSH 会话中提供全局 show_image 工具，并为工具调用注册浏览器卡片。用户可让 agent 根据本地文件路径读取支持的图片并在对话中内联预览；点击缩略图可打开全屏放大视图。图片由浏览器通过专用 HTTP 路由按需加载。适合需要在网页会话中查看本机图片的 DSH 用户；使用前需安装 DSH 并启用 Web profile，不需要额外 API 密钥或外部账号。

dsh-plugin-show-image adds a global show_image tool and browser card to DSH Web. The agent displays a local image inline; clicking it opens a full-screen view. An HTTP route serves image bytes on demand. Requires the DSH Web profile; no API key or external account.
想让 DSH 在网页对话里直接显示本地图片。
怎么在 DSH 会话中预览图片并点击放大？
I want to show a local image inline in my DSH web chat.
dsh-plugin-show-image 的功能「会话内图片预览」：在 Web 会话中调用 show_image 并传入图片路径，工具读取图像信息后由会话卡片内联显示图片。
dsh-plugin-show-image 的功能「图片放大查看」：点击会话卡片中的图片即可打开全屏 lightbox；点击浮层或按 Escape 可关闭。

[DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的会话内图片渲染插件：
对话模型调用 `show_image` 工具即可在浏览器会话界面中**内联显示本地图片**。
图片字节通过按需 HTTP 路由传输，不进入会话日志或模型上下文——轻量、无膨胀。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 特性：- 🖼 **内联图片渲染**：在对话流中直接显示本地图片，无需离开会话界面
- 🔍 **点击放大**：缩略图可点击，打开全屏 lightbox 浮层查看大图；点击任意位置或按 Escape 关闭
- 🌐 **HTTP 按需传输**：图片字节走专用 HTTP 路由（`GET /show-image?path=…`），不经 base64 编码、不进会话日志
- 📦 **零依赖零构建**：纯手写 JavaScript，无 npm 依赖、无构建步骤、无 TypeScript
- 🔒 **安全守卫**：8MB 文件大小上限、扩展名白名单（防原型链污染）、不支持的格式直接拒绝
- 🧹 **完全可逆**：所有副作用（工具注册、HTTP 路由、卡片渲染器）绑定在插件 fiber 上，卸载即清理
dsh-plugin-show-image README · 支持格式：`png` · `jpg` / `jpeg` · `gif` · `webp` · `svg` · `bmp` · `avif` · `ico`

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 安装：前置：已安装 [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 且 `pnpm` 在 PATH 上。

```sh
dsh-plugin-show-image README · 从 GitHub 安装（零构建步骤，无需 allowBuilds 配置）：dsh plugin --profile web add github:justhalfbit/dsh-plugin-show-image

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 界面支持：| 运行形态 | 工具 + 路由（Host 半） | 卡片渲染（Client 半） |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh web`（浏览器 GUI） | ✅ | ✅ |
| `tui` / `headless` | ❌ 依赖 `webServer`，无此服务时整行不激活 | ❌ |

这是有意为之：在无渲染面的终端里注册一个"假装能显示图片"的工具只会误导模型。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 使用方式：安装并重启后，所有会话（任何 preset）都自动获得 `show_image` 工具。直接对 agent 说：

```
把 /path/to/image.png 显示出来
```

agent 会调用 `show_image` 工具，图片即内联渲染在会话卡片中。点击图片可全屏查看。

> **提示**：建议使用绝对路径。相对路径会按 DSH 进程的工作目录解析，而非会话工作目录。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 架构：插件由两个半体组成，通过 HTTP 路由松耦合：

```
┌─ Host 半 (lib/index.js) ──────────────────────────────┐
│                                                        │
│  show_image 工具                                        │
│    模型调用 → execute() → fs.readBytes()                │

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 一次调用的完整链路：1. **模型决策**：agent 循环把 `show_image` 工具 schema 编入请求，模型决定调用并返回 `{path}` 2. **工具执行**：Host 端 `execute()` 用 `fs` 服务读取文件元数据，返回 `{path, mime, bytes}` — 图片字节**不进日志** 3. **卡片渲染**：会话事件同步到浏览器，React 渲染 `ImageCard`，输出 `` 4. **按需取图**：浏览器 `` 标签自动发起 HTTP GET，命中 `/show-image` 路由，Handler 返回图片字节 三个调用方（agent 循环、React 渲染器、HTTP 服务器）互不感知，靠会话日志和 URL 松耦合衔接。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Lightbox 实现：点击缩略图后，`useEffect` 直接在 `document.body` 上创建 DOM 浮层（而非 React 树内渲染），
避免任何祖先 CSS（`transform` / `filter` / `overflow`）对 `position: fixed` 的裁剪。
同时锁定页面滚动（`overflow: hidden`），Escape 键关闭，组件卸载时自动清理所有副作用。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 文件结构：```
dsh-plugin-show-image/
├── package.json          # 包声明：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + exports
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 组合补丁：一行 insert，把本包挂进 host 组合
├── lib/

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 设计决策：**为什么图片走 HTTP 路由而不是 base64 RPC？**
base64 编码膨胀 33%，且整段数据必须通过 JSON 序列化/反序列化。HTTP 路由让浏览器直接获取原始字节，
体积更小、传输更快。

**为什么挂 host 平面？**
`show_image` 应该对所有会话可见（全局工具），而非仅限某个 preset。host 层的 `tools.register()` 注册为全局工具，
所有会话（不分 preset）都能看到。同时 `webServer` 服务仅在 host 层可用。

**为什么 `webServer` 缺失时整行不激活？**
`inject: ['tools', 'fs', 'webServer']` 声明了硬依赖。在 TUI/headless profile 中 `webServer` 不存在，
Cordis 会让该行进入 waiting 状态而永不激活——这比注册一个无法渲染的假工具更诚实。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 设计决策：**为什么 lightbox 用原生 DOM 而不是 React？**
React 渲染的元素受制于 DOM 树中祖先节点的 CSS 属性。`position: fixed` 会被祖先的 `transform`、`filter`
等属性降级为相对定位。直接挂载到 `document.body` 上的 DOM 元素不受此限制，保证 lightbox 始终全屏覆盖。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · 已知限制：- 仅适用于 `dsh web`（浏览器 GUI）profile，TUI / headless 环境下不可用
- 相对路径按 DSH 进程工作目录解析，而非会话工作目录（工具描述中已提示模型优先使用绝对路径）
- 本机任何进程可通过 GUI 端口读取本地图片文件，与 DSH GUI 既有的本地信任模型一致
dsh-plugin-show-image README · 开发：本插件零依赖零构建。修改源码后重启 `dsh web` 即可生效（本地链接安装不需要重新 `dsh plugin add`）。

dsh-plugin-show-image README · dsh-plugin-show-image：[中文](README.md) | English

An inline image rendering plugin for [DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness):
the conversation agent calls the `show_image` tool to **display local images inline** in the
browser session UI. Image bytes travel through an on-demand HTTP route — they never enter the
session log or the model context. Lightweight and zero-bloat.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Features：- 🖼 **Inline image rendering**: display local images directly in the conversation flow without
  leaving the session UI
- 🔍 **Click to enlarge**: click the thumbnail to open a full-viewport lightbox overlay; click
  anywhere or press Escape to close
- 🌐 **On-demand HTTP delivery**: image bytes flow through a dedicated HTTP route
  (`GET /show-image?path=…`) — no base64 encoding, no session log bloat
- 📦 **Zero dependencies, zero build**: hand-written plain JavaScript — no npm dependencies, no
  build step, no TypeScript
- 🔒 **Safety guardrails**: 8MB file size cap, extension allowlist (prototype-chain safe), and
  unsupported formats are rejected outright
- 🧹 **Fully reversible**: every side effect (tool registration, HTTP route, card renderer) is
  bound to the plugin fiber and cleaned up on uninstall
dsh-plugin-show-image README · Supported formats：`png` · `jpg` / `jpeg` · `gif` · `webp` · `svg` · `bmp` · `avif` · `ico`

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Installation：Prerequisites: [DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installed and `pnpm` on
PATH.

```sh

text:
dsh-plugin-show-image README · Interface support：| Runtime | Tool + route (Host half) | Card rendering (Client half) |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh web` (browser GUI) | ✅ | ✅ |
| `tui` / `headless` | ❌ depends on `webServer`; the row stays inactive without it | ❌ |

This is by design: registering an image tool in a terminal that cannot render images would only
mislead the model.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Usage：After installation and restart, every session (any preset) automatically gains the `show_image`
tool. Just tell the agent:

```
Show me /path/to/image.png
```

The agent calls `show_image`, and the image renders inline in the conversation card. Click the
image to view it full-screen.

> **Tip**: prefer absolute paths. Relative paths resolve against the DSH process working
> directory, not the session working directory.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Architecture：The plugin consists of two halves, loosely coupled through an HTTP route:

```
┌─ Host half (lib/index.js) ─────────────────────────────┐
│                                                         │
│  show_image tool                                        │
│    model calls → execute() → fs.readBytes()             │

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Full call chain：1. **Model decision**: the agent loop encodes the `show_image` tool schema into the request; the model decides to call it and returns `{path}` 2. **Tool execution**: the Host `execute()` reads file metadata via the `fs` service and returns `{path, mime, bytes}` — image bytes **never enter the log** 3. **Card rendering**: session events sync to the browser; React renders `ImageCard`, which outputs `` 4. **On-demand fetch**: the browser `` tag fires an HTTP GET that hits the `/show-image` route; the handler serves back the image bytes

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Full call chain：The three callers (agent loop, React renderer, HTTP server) are unaware of each other; they
connect through the session log and the URL.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Lightbox implementation：When the thumbnail is clicked, a `useEffect` appends a plain DOM overlay directly to
`document.body` (instead of rendering inside the React tree), bypassing any ancestor CSS
(`transform` / `filter` / `overflow`) that would clip a `position: fixed` element. Page scroll
is locked (`overflow: hidden`), the Escape key closes the overlay, and all side effects are
cleaned up on close or component unmount.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · File structure：```
dsh-plugin-show-image/
├── package.json          # Package manifest: dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + exports
├── cordis.patch.yml      # Composition patch: one insert row into the host tree
├── lib/

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Design decisions：**Why an HTTP route instead of base64 RPC?**
Base64 encoding inflates the payload by 33%, and the entire blob must pass through JSON
serialization/deserialization. An HTTP route lets the browser fetch raw bytes directly —
smaller and faster.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Design decisions：**Why the host plane?**
`show_image` should be visible to every session (a global tool), not limited to one preset.
`tools.register()` on the host plane registers a global tool visible to all sessions regardless
of preset. The `webServer` service is also only available on the host plane.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Design decisions：**Why does the row stay inactive when `webServer` is missing?**
`inject: ['tools', 'fs', 'webServer']` declares a hard dependency. In TUI/headless profiles
where `webServer` does not exist, Cordis puts the row in a permanent waiting state — this is
more honest than registering a broken tool that pretends it can render images.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Design decisions：**Why native DOM instead of React for the lightbox?**
React-rendered elements are subject to ancestor CSS properties in the DOM tree. `position:
fixed` is downgraded to relative positioning by ancestors with `transform`, `filter`, etc.
A DOM element mounted directly on `document.body` is immune to these constraints, guaranteeing
the lightbox always covers the full viewport.

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Known limitations：- Only available in the `dsh web` (browser GUI) profile; not functional in TUI / headless
  environments
- Relative paths resolve against the DSH process working directory, not the session working
  directory (the tool description instructs the model to prefer absolute paths)
- Any local process can read local image files through the GUI port — consistent with DSH's
  existing local trust model

dsh-plugin-show-image README · Development：This plugin has zero dependencies and zero build steps. Edit the source, restart `dsh web`,
and the changes take effect (local-linked installs do not need `dsh plugin add` again).
